info.title: Kavrigo Control Plane
info.description:
Kavrigo control plane.

Kavrigo is a platform for building, testing and governing AI trading agents. Agents produce
structured, evidence-backed decisions; a deterministic risk engine outside the model decides
whether an order intent is permitted.

**This release is paper and research only.** Live execution is disabled and gated on the
readiness checklist in the master specification. Backtest and paper results are simulations, not
live results, and nothing here is investment advice.

AgentCreate.title: AgentCreate
AgentCreate.description:
Create an agent and its first version.

The spec is validated as a full :class:`kavrigo_domain.AgentSpec` before anything is
written, so an invalid configuration never reaches the database or a run.

AgentDecision.title: AgentDecision
AgentDecision.description: A validated proposal bound to server-owned context by the agent runtime. Not an order.

AgentSpec.title: AgentSpec
AgentSpec.description: The declarative agent specification a user reviews and approves.

AgentVersionCreate.title: AgentVersionCreate
AgentVersionCreate.description:
Create a new version of an existing agent.

There is no update endpoint by design: editing an agent creates a version, it does not mutate
the configuration that produced historical decisions (``MASTER_BUILD_SPEC.md`` §3, §38).

AgentVersionResponse.title: AgentVersionResponse
AgentVersionResponse.description: A version with its full specification.

AuthorKind.title: AuthorKind
AuthorKind.description: Whether a version's changes were written by a human or generated (§38).

DataFamily.title: DataFamily
DataFamily.description: Data families that carry independent freshness budgets (``MASTER_BUILD_SPEC.md`` §11.3).

DataPack.title: DataPack
DataPack.description:
Explicitly enabled data families (``MASTER_BUILD_SPEC.md`` §7).

Packs are opt-in per agent because they carry both cost and licence entitlement (§8.3).

DecisionState.title: DecisionState
DecisionState.description: The agent's read of the situation (``MASTER_BUILD_SPEC.md`` §6.7).

EvidenceItem.title: EvidenceItem
EvidenceItem.description:
One immutable, attributable piece of evidence available to a decision.

``content_hash`` makes the item verifiable after the fact: a stored decision can be replayed
against exactly the evidence that produced it.

EvidenceKind.title: EvidenceKind
EvidenceKind.description: What family of evidence this is, matching the signal families in §7.

EvidenceRequirements.title: EvidenceRequirements
EvidenceRequirements.description: What an agent must have before it is permitted to act (``MASTER_BUILD_SPEC.md`` §9).

FreshnessPolicy.title: FreshnessPolicy
FreshnessPolicy.description:
Maximum tolerated data age per family, in milliseconds (``MASTER_BUILD_SPEC.md`` §11.3).

Data freshness is part of risk (``AGENTS.md`` domain rule 5): a correct decision on stale
data is still a wrong trade.

InstrumentClass.title: InstrumentClass
InstrumentClass.description:
What kind of contract an instrument is.

Only ``SPOT`` is executable in V1 (ADR 0002). Derivatives appear here because their *data*
is a first-class signal source (``MASTER_BUILD_SPEC.md`` §7.3) even though the platform does
not trade them.

venue.title: Venue
venue.description: Uppercase venue or data-source identifier, e.g. BINANCE, COINBASE, SIM.

InstrumentId.title: InstrumentId
InstrumentId.description:
A tradable or observable instrument, unambiguous across venues and contract types.

Canonical string form is ``BASE-QUOTE.VENUE`` for spot, and ``BASE-QUOTE.VENUE:CLASS`` for
everything else — for example ``BTC-USDT.BINANCE`` and ``BTC-USDT.BINANCE:perpetual``.

MarketRegime.title: MarketRegime
MarketRegime.description:
Regime labels from ``MASTER_BUILD_SPEC.md`` §44.

The label set is closed on purpose: a model may interpret regime context, but it may not
invent unbounded regime labels during execution, because downstream policy keys off them.

MeResponse.title: MeResponse
MeResponse.description:
Who the caller is, and what they can reach.

``permissions`` is returned per workspace so the client can hide actions it cannot perform.
The server re-checks every one of them — a hidden button is a usability feature, never a
security control.

ModelCallRecord.title: ModelCallRecord
ModelCallRecord.description:
What the model gateway actually did, for cost accounting and reproducibility.

``resolved_model_identifier`` is recorded rather than the profile alone: a routing fallback
must never silently change which model produced a reproducible result (ADR 0010).

ModelProfile.title: ModelProfile
ModelProfile.description:
Routing profiles, not model names (``MASTER_BUILD_SPEC.md`` §13.5).

Product behaviour must not be hard-coded to a current model name; the gateway resolves a
profile to a concrete model, and the resolved identifier is recorded on the decision.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Uppercase asset or currency code, e.g. BTC, ETH, USDT, USD.

Money.title: Money
Money.description:
An amount in a specific currency.

Arithmetic is deliberately restrictive: adding USD to USDT is a bug, not a conversion, and
this type will not quietly perform one.

NewsEvent.title: NewsEvent
NewsEvent.description:
A structured news event extracted from untrusted text (``MASTER_BUILD_SPEC.md`` §7.12).

The extraction step is where an article stops being text and becomes data. Sentiment alone
is close to useless; credibility, novelty, certainty and expected horizon are what make an
event actionable or not.

PaperPolicyReviewCreate.title: PaperPolicyReviewCreate
PaperPolicyReviewCreate.description: A second person's recommendation; never an execution authorization.

live_trading_enabled.title: Live Trading Enabled
live_trading_enabled.description: Always false in this release. Live execution is gated on MASTER_BUILD_SPEC.md §47 and ADR 0001.

PlatformModeResponse.title: PlatformModeResponse
PlatformModeResponse.description: The authoritative trading-mode state for the whole platform.

PortfolioSnapshot.title: PortfolioSnapshot
PortfolioSnapshot.description: Point-in-time portfolio state used by the portfolio and risk layers.

Position.title: Position
Position.description: A held position. Negative quantity represents short exposure (not executable in V1).

Prediction.title: Prediction
Prediction.description: A quantified expectation with explicit uncertainty.

base.title: Base
base.description: Uppercase asset or currency code, e.g. BTC, ETH, USDT, USD.

quote.title: Quote
quote.description: Uppercase asset or currency code, e.g. BTC, ETH, USDT, USD.

Price.title: Price
Price.description: A price expressed as quote currency per one unit of the base asset.

PromotionStage.title: PromotionStage
PromotionStage.description:
Promotion pipeline stages (``MASTER_BUILD_SPEC.md`` §12.6).

A failed gate produces a new version; it never rewrites history.

ProposedAction.title: ProposedAction
ProposedAction.description:
The only actions a model may propose (``MASTER_BUILD_SPEC.md`` §6.6).

This is a closed set on purpose. A model cannot propose "withdraw", "transfer", "change
risk policy", or any free-form instruction, because those words have no representation here.

asset.title: Asset
asset.description: Uppercase asset or currency code, e.g. BTC, ETH, USDT, USD.

Quantity.title: Quantity
Quantity.description: A quantity of an asset. Negative values represent short exposure.

RiskExecutionPolicy.title: RiskExecutionPolicy
RiskExecutionPolicy.description: Local USD-spot MARKET/IOC only. Assumptions are operator configuration, not venue facts.

RiskLimits-Input.title: RiskLimits
RiskLimits-Input.description: Exposure and loss limits. Percentages are of portfolio equity unless stated.

RiskLimits-Output.title: RiskLimits
RiskLimits-Output.description: Exposure and loss limits. Percentages are of portfolio equity unless stated.

RiskPolicy.title: RiskPolicy
RiskPolicy.description:
An immutable, versioned risk policy.

Policies are referenced by id from an ``AgentSpec`` and recorded on every evaluation, so a
historical rejection can be explained with the policy that actually applied.

RiskScope.title: RiskScope
RiskScope.description: The limit hierarchy (``MASTER_BUILD_SPEC.md`` §11.2), most general first.

Role.title: Role
Role.description:
Workspace roles, least privileged last.

``OWNER`` and ``ADMIN`` are distinguished because deleting a workspace, or removing its last
owner, should not be available to everyone who can administer agents.

SignalScores.title: SignalScores
SignalScores.description:
Per-family signal contributions, each in [-1, 1].

Signal families rather than raw indicators: dumping hundreds of indicators into a model
produces confident noise (``MASTER_BUILD_SPEC.md`` §7).

SourceClass.title: SourceClass
SourceClass.description:
Source classes from ``MASTER_BUILD_SPEC.md`` §42.

Source class informs confidence. It never establishes truth: an official account can be
compromised, and a wire service can be wrong.

TradingMode.title: TradingMode
TradingMode.description:
The four product modes (``MASTER_BUILD_SPEC.md`` §5).

``LIVE`` exists in the type system so that code can reason about it, and is refused at
runtime unless the live gate is open (ADR 0001).
